# Welcome to the Moderation Arena

<!-- DRAFT v1 — edit freely. This file is shown on the landing page after sign-in (re-read on every page load). Markdown. -->

Social media platforms each have their own content policy, so the **same post** can be allowed on one platform and
restricted on another. In this study, an AI model was asked to moderate real posts under the policies of different
platforms. Your job is to look at the post and judge **which platform's decision you find better**.

## What you will see

For every round you get:

* **One post** from Bluesky, TikTok or X — text, and sometimes images, a video and its audio transcript.
  If the post is not in English, use the *Translate to English* button under the text or transcript.
* **Two decisions** by the same model, from two different platform policies (**Policy A** and **Policy B**).
  Each decision has a **label** (what kind of content the policy considers the post to be, or *no-moderation*)
  and an **action** (what the platform would do, such as *Remove*, *Restrict reach*, *Hide*, or *No action*).

The platform names are hidden while you vote, and which policy is on the left is random.

## How to vote

1. Read the post. Open the media or the transcript if there is any.
2. Compare the two **labels**. Mark which policy's label fits the post better: **A**, **B**, **Both** (equally good) or **Neither** (neither is good).
3. Do the same for the two **actions**.
4. Press **Submit vote**.

After you vote, the two platforms are revealed, together with the **policy quotes** each decision relied on and the
model's **explanation**. These are hidden before the vote so they do not influence your choice.

Then press **Next post** to continue. If you are unsure about a post or would rather not judge it, press **Skip**.

## Good to know

* **Content warning.** The posts are sampled from real platform data and may contain graphic, sexual, violent or hateful content.
  You can skip any post, and stop at any time.
* **Your name** is only used to save your votes together. Enter the same name next time to continue where you left off.
* **There are no right or wrong answers** — we are interested in your own judgement. You can read a policy in full with **Show full policy**.
* The **Leaderboard** in the sidebar shows how the policies rank based on everyone's votes.
